name: Winter Panzanella Salad with Butternut Squash & Apples
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F and position rack in the centre.
Wash squash, trim ends, and peel. Halve lengthwise, scape out seeds, and medium dice the flesh.
Place squash on a baking sheet, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt, pepper, and cumin; toss to coat. Place in the oven and roast until tender, 15-20 minutes.
Cube bread into 1 inch pieces. Peel and mince garlic.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Finely grate ¼ cup of Parmesan.
Melt butter in skillet. Add garlic and sage; stir until fragrant. Add bread cubes and toast, tossing often, until they begin to brown, 4-5 minutes.
In a medium bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together olive oil, vinegar, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
Add Parmesan, pumpkin seeds, salt, and pepper to croutons; continue to toss until bread is golden brown and crispy, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Wash and dry kale. Fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and transfer to a salad bowl.
Wash, core, and thinly slice apples; add to salad bowl. Peel and thinly slice shallots; add to salad bowl.
Add squash, croutons, and pumpkin seeds to salad bowl; toss to combine.
To serve, arrange salad on a plate and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
